tax.heading: Provision for Income Taxes
tax.text: Our provision for income taxes for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 resulted in an effective income tax rate of 21.0%, 23.7%, 22.8% and 25.2% respectively. The effective tax rate differed from the federal statutory rate of 21.0% for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 principally due to state and local income taxes and certain non-deductible executive compensation, offset in part by the effect of presenting the bargain purchase gain net of deferred taxes.

net.heading: Net Income
net.text: Net income was $10.0 million and $4.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, and $14.9 million and $12.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. Net income from continuing operations was $10.4 million and $4.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively and $14.3 million and $12.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. The three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 included a non-recurring, bargain purchase gain net of deferred taxes of $6.5 million recognized in connection with the Tallied acquisition; this gain was exempt from income tax as the related deferred taxes were recorded in acquisition accounting. Discontinued operations resulted in a loss, net of tax, of $0.4 million and income, net of tax of $0.6 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively. The remaining changes in net income for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same periods in 2025, were primarily the result of the factors discussed in the foregoing sections.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income and NIM
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income was the primary contributor to our earnings in 2026 and 2025. Net interest income is affected by changes in the amount and mix of interest-earning assets and interest-bearing liabilities, referred to as “volume changes.” It is also affected by changes in yields earned on interest-earning assets and rates paid on interest-bearing deposits and other borrowed funds, referred to as “rate changes.”

Net interest income increased for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025, primarily due to growth in credit enhanced loans, as well as a change in estimate, based on additional information and experience, regarding the allocation of interest received on credit enhanced loans in excess of the amount we retain. We now estimate that all excess interest is attributable to servicing and credit guarantee expense.

intro.text: We are FinWise Bancorp, a Utah bank holding company headquartered in Murray, Utah. We operate through our wholly-owned subsidiary, FinWise Bank, a Utah state-chartered bank. Our business is conducted through three reportable segments: traditional banking, banking as a service (“BaaS”) and treasury & administration. We currently operate one full-service banking location in Sandy, Utah. We are a nationwide lender to consumers and small businesses. We believe that traditional barriers to servicing banking customers have been substantially lowered due to technological advances in the distribution and management of banking products and services. We seek to capitalize on these advances by leveraging strategic relationships, as well as proprietary loan origination systems and data analytics technology, to expand our reach in marketing channels utilized and credit products offered.

lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.
